prompt.zh-CN: 一个开源模型在某公开数学 benchmark 上分数异常高。最先做什么？
prompt.en-US: An open model scores suspiciously high on a public math benchmark. What do you do first?

scenario.zh-CN: 模型的预训练数据没有公开。
scenario.en-US: Its pretraining data is not public.

text.zh-CN: 对题目做改写或换数值，看分数是否明显下降
text.en-US: Rewrite or re-number the problems and see whether the score drops

why.zh-CN: 污染的典型信号是对原题记忆好、对等价改写差；不需要训练数据也能测。
why.en-US: Contamination shows as recalling the originals but failing equivalent rewrites; testable without the training data.

text.zh-CN: 直接采信，换个 benchmark 再跑一次
text.en-US: Accept it and run another benchmark

why.zh-CN: 另一个公开集也可能被污染，问题没有被检验。
why.en-US: Another public set may be contaminated too; the question is never tested.

why.zh-CN: 样本量解决方差，不解决污染。
why.en-US: Sample size addresses variance, not contamination.

explanation.zh-CN: 用扰动后的等价题区分“会做”和“背过”。
explanation.en-US: Equivalent perturbed problems separate solving from memorising.

hints.zh-CN: 背过答案和会做题，在改写后表现有什么不同？
hints.en-US: How do memorising and solving differ under rewriting?
